summary: Tanda E (frontend-only): tested CarnetSheet refactor on /admin/carnets and /mi-equipo. All required testids present, selection/toggle/filter/tab-clear behaviour works as specified. Admin sees 6 approved players globally and filter narrows to 3 for Club de Prueba; DT sees exactly the 3 approved players of their own club and lockedTeamId hides the team filter as expected. No regressions detected on legacy testids.
critical_code_review_comments: CarnetSheet.jsx is well-scoped and reusable; props lockedTeamId effectively hides team filter and forces filtering. Good use of data-testid prefixing.
Minor noise: React DOM warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' originates from the preview tooling overlay injecting x-ve-dynamic spans into <option>, not from app source — no action needed.

Approved-players filter on /mi-equipo uses `!p.status || p.status === "aprobado"`, which works because /api/teams/{tid}/players returns players whose status field is null when approved by admin (verified empirically). Consider explicit status='aprobado' set on DB approve action for clarity.
AdminCarnets falls back to non-filtered fetch on error, masking actual API errors silently. Consider logging or surfacing the failure.
